test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which major initiative was highlighted by the New Delhi government to mark its first 100 days in office, as detailed in the report titled 'Kaam Karne Wali Sarkar: 100 Din Seva Ke'?

options.text: Launch of a new metro line
Introduction of a universal basic income
Inauguration of a new legislative building
Presentation of a report card highlighting achievements

solution:
The correct answer is __**Presentation of a report card highlighting achievements**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The New Delhi government marked its first 100 days in office by presenting a report titled **'Kaam Karne Wali Sarkar: 100 Din Seva Ke'**, showcasing its achievements and initiatives taken during this period.
 
• The report card emphasized transparency and accountability, highlighting the government's focus on delivering results and fulfilling pre-election promises.
 
• Key initiatives mentioned in the report included measures to enhance public welfare in areas like **education, healthcare, and infrastructure**, which are vital sectors for societal development.
 
• The initiative aimed to inform citizens about the progress made in various projects and the government's commitment to improving governance and services.
 
• Such presentations act as tools for public scrutiny and enable people to evaluate the government's performance effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Transparency in Governance:**

 
 
• Governments often present achievement reports to enhance **public trust** and ensure transparency in governance.
 
• These reports serve as a medium to highlight progress, challenges, and areas requiring improvement.
 
• For example, the Delhi government has consistently emphasized education and healthcare reforms as part of its governance model.
 
 
 
• **Key Initiatives of the Delhi Government:**
 
 
• **Education:** Introduction of programs like **Happiness Curriculum** and infrastructure upgrades in schools.
 
• **Healthcare:** Establishment of **Mohalla Clinics** to provide accessible healthcare services.
 
• **Transport:** Expansion of public transportation facilities and subsidies for certain groups.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Report Cards in Governance:**
 
 
• Report cards enable citizens to hold governments accountable and track the progress of promised initiatives.
 
• They provide insights into the allocation of resources and the efficiency of implemented policies.
 
• Such reports also help governments to identify gaps and prioritize future actions effectively.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Similar Initiatives:**
 
 
• Other state governments like **Maharashtra** and **Kerala** have also adopted similar practices to present their achievements.
 
• These initiatives are crucial in fostering a culture of transparency and citizen engagement in governance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Accountability:**

 
 
• Regular updates through reports help foster accountability and trust between the government and citizens.
 
• They provide a platform for constructive criticism, allowing governments to address shortcomings effectively.
 
 
 
• **Public Engagement:**
 
 
• Reports like **'Kaam Karne Wali Sarkar'** enable citizens to actively participate in governance by staying informed about initiatives and policies.
 
• They ensure a two-way communication system, where public opinions can also influence policy-making.
 
 
 
• **Global Examples:**
 
 
• Globally, countries like **New Zealand** and **Canada** release regular progress reports on governance to maintain transparency.
 
• These practices are recognized as a benchmark for effective democratic governance.
